title: Hand Paint It!
description: A datapack allowing you to paint blocks using right click with a dye.
body:
# Hand-Paint It! ## What does it do? All dye you acquire will be modified to let you use it with a right click.
Using it on blocks that can be colored will recolor the block, as shown in the video below. ### Supported Blocks for recoloring - Wool - Carpets - Terracotta - Glazed Terracotta - Concrete - Concrete Powder - Glass Blocks - Glass Panes
